description: This file defines the NumberValue class used to represent DynamoDB Number (N) values in the AWS SDK for PHP. It implements JsonSerializable to allow easy JSON encoding and provides string conversion.

classes.name: NumberValue
classes.description: A class to encapsulate a DynamoDB Number value, supporting JSON serialization and string conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the NumberValue with a given number, casting it to string.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Returns the value for JSON serialization.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the number value.
